name: Clocks and Colours
production_model: Designed in Toronto, hand-carved in Bali

prices.note: Full catalog, product_type Rings: 115 rings, 7 marked down (excluded), 108 regular. Stainless steel from $69 (No Looking Back, Salt & Bone); sterling silver from about $129 (Salt & Bone in silver) to $359 (Victory). '30 OFF'/'Discountable' tags with no compare-at are not markdowns. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price (Shopify products.json, the test product-images.mjs uses); price-zero items excluded.

notes: About: founded 2013 by Shane Vitaly and Jason Readman, Toronto, flagship at 154 Ossington; jewellery 'cast in stainless steel and sterling silver'; also fragrance, apparel, eyewear. Store description: 'designed in Toronto, Canada and hand-carved in Bali by master silversmiths'.

Shipping: 'ships orders worldwide' from a Canadian warehouse (outside the EU) and a Portugal warehouse (EU and Switzerland); banner 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS $100+ USD'. ships_to from meta.json (235 incl. US, CA, GB, AU).
Returns: 'exchange or return your product up to 30 days after delivery as long as your item is not a final sale item'; earrings not returnable; clearance for store credit only.
Named rings: Salt & Bone ($69 steel, $129 silver; small skull on a bone band, Peter McKinnon collaboration), Shadow's Wake ($289, sterling silver raven with ivy and thorns band).
